text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
My bad, my bad. Can't believe someone like 
me went and forgot her bag. There we go...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
W-What was that?! ...Was it just my 
imagination? Damn it, nearly gave me a 
heart attack...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...Ain't nobody there, right? I mean, even 
if it's a ghost, the great Inari-sama 
ain't ever gonna get spooked, but—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek!?!? Get outta here, you big dumb 
jerk, ya numbskull blockheeead!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...The next day. When I mentioned that a 
stray cat seemed to have gotten into the 
Trainer's room, Inari One nodded with a 
strangely exhausted look."
